title: Privacy Policy
translationNote: This translation is provided for convenience. If it differs from the English version of this policy, the English version applies.

summary.title: Summary
summary.body: SoloSuite does not collect, store, or share any personal information. The app has no account system, no analytics, no advertising, and no server backend. Everything you do in the app stays on your device.

stored.title: Data stored on your device
stored.body: SoloSuite saves your game statistics, favorites, settings, and in-progress games using on-device local storage. This information never leaves your device, is never transmitted to us or to any third party, and is removed automatically if you uninstall the app or clear its data.

collected.title: Data we collect
collected.body: None. SoloSuite does not use analytics, crash reporting, or advertising services, and does not ask for or store your name, email address, location, or any other personal information.

links.title: External links
links.body: A small number of screens include optional links to external websites (for example, photo attribution credits). Tapping one of these opens your device's web browser or the linked site directly. SoloSuite has no control over, and is not responsible for, the privacy practices of those external sites.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.body: SoloSuite does not knowingly collect any information from anyone, including children, because it does not collect information from any user.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy ever changes, an updated version will be published at this same address with a revised date above.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to <link>{{email}}</link>.
